build_resnet_fpn_backbone: build a ResNet FPN backbone using detectron2 config with LastLevelMaxPool top block
build_retinanet_resnet_fpn_backbone: build a RetinaNet ResNet FPN backbone using detectron2 config with P6 and P7 extra layers
create_FPN_module: create an FPN module with a bottom-up backbone, lateral convs, and output convs for pyramid features
create_LastLevelMaxPool: create a LastLevelMaxPool top block that generates a downsampled P6 feature from P5
create_LastLevelP6P7: create a LastLevelP6P7 top block that generates P6 and P7 layers from the C5 feature
